data.exact_reserve_text:
Change of estimate
During the period, the managing agent refined its methodology for estimating claims reserves, including revising the actuarial methodology behind determining the risk margin to determine the appropriate level of margin in reserves. These changes have been accounted for prospectively as a change in estimate. As a result of these changes the reserves were strengthened by $4.1m in the period (on a net of reinsurance basis).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reduction in previously accrued reinstatement premiums associated with Hurricane Ian; contributed to reduced reinsurance premium payable and impacted year-on-year premium/reinsurance amounts.

named_events.loss_description: Decrease in previously accrued reinstatement premiums associated with Hurricane Ian; referenced in relation to reduced reinsurance premium year on year.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2022 was 138.7 (statement currency). During 2023 the managing agent implemented a change of estimate (refining actuarial methodology and risk margin), which was accounted for prospectively and resulted in a net strengthening of reserves of $4.1m (net of reinsurance). Broader claims experience was favourable (a relatively quiet weather-related natural catastrophe season), contributing to an improved claims ratio, but no gross prior-year movement in the insurance-liabilities column was explicitly disclosed, so the quantified movement available is the $4.1m net strengthening.
raw_causal_phrases: reserves were strengthened by $4.1m in the period (on a net of reinsurance basis).
revising the actuarial methodology behind determining the risk margin
relatively quiet weather related natural catastrophe season during the year.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (insurance-liabilities column) was presented in the notes. The report explicitly discloses a $4.1m strengthening 'on a net of reinsurance basis' (used here as the quantified prior year movement). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the balance sheet (gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2022 = 138.7). Gross premium mix amounts were estimated by applying the reported percentages to total gross written premium (percentages sourced from the analysis of underwriting result); these are approximations. All monetary amounts are in the report's native currency (USD).
